description: Search any TravelClick-powered hotel's own rates directly -- room types, rate plans, fee-inclusive pricing, and the cheapest night to book -- without opening a browser tab per property.

tools.name: codes_validate_corporate
tools.description: Check whether a corporate / rate-access code is valid for this hotel. Returns 200 when valid; returns a structured error (surfaced by the CLI) when the code is unrecognized. Required: hotel_id, code.

tools.name: codes_validate_group
tools.description: Check whether a group-attendee code is valid for this hotel. Returns 200 when valid; returns a structured error (surfaced by the CLI) when the code is unrecognized. Required: hotel_id, code.

tools.name: hotel_info
tools.description: Fetch a hotel's public profile: name, address, geolocation, check-in/out times, accepted cards, and textual policies (cancellation, pets, parking, resort/curation fees). Required: hotel_id. Optional: lang (default: EN_US). Returns the HotelInfo.

tools.name: rates_calendar
tools.description: Scan a date range (up to ~60 days) for the lowest available rate per night -- use this to find the cheapest night to check in before running a full search. Required: hotel_id, hotelCode, from, to, multiRoomOccupancy. Optional: lang (default: EN_US), currency (default: USD), bookerIdentifier (plus 1 more). Returns array of MultiRoomDate.

params.name: hotelCode
params.description: Same numeric ID as hotel_id -- the API expects it in both the path and the body.

params.name: from
params.description: Start of the scan window, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: to
params.description: End of the scan window, YYYY-MM-DD. Windows longer than ~60 days may be truncated by the API.

params.name: currency
params.description: ISO currency code for displayed rates.

params.name: multiRoomOccupancy
params.description: Occupancy per room being scanned. The widget always sends exactly one entry for a single-room calendar scan.

tools.name: rates_search
tools.description: Search available rooms and rate plans for a hotel between check-in and check-out. Required: hotel_id, check-in, check-out. Optional: adults (default: 2), infants (default: 0), rooms (default: 1) (plus 4 more). Returns array of AvailRoomStay.

params.name: hotel_id
params.description: TravelClick numeric hotel ID (e.g. 102306 for Made Hotel NYC). Found in the hotel's booking URL: bookings.travelclick.com/{hotel_id}.

params.name: adults
params.description: Number of adults for the room.

params.name: infants
params.description: Number of infants (does not count against occupancy).

params.name: currency
params.description: ISO currency code for displayed rates.

params.name: channel
params.description: Booking-engine channel identifier the widget itself sends. Leave at the default unless you know why you'd change it.

params.name: bookerIdentifier
params.description: Optional OTA/travel-agent booker attribution ID. Leave blank for a direct search.

novel_features.name: Multi-hotel rate compare
novel_features.description: Check several boutique hotels for the same dates in one call, ranked by lowest fee-inclusive total.

novel_features.name: Cheapest night across saved hotels
novel_features.description: Scan several hotels' calendars at once and return the single best hotel+date combination.

novel_features.name: Saved hotel aliases
novel_features.description: Give a memorable name to a TravelClick hotel ID instead of memorizing a 6-digit number.

novel_features.name: Rate-snapshot price-drift history
novel_features.description: Track how a hotel's rates move over time from your own saved search history.

novel_features.name: Rate-code check across saved hotels
novel_features.description: Test one corporate or group code against every saved hotel at once.
